correctness.rationale: Ball power-potential averages are comparable to (|x|+r)^{2α}, giving critical ρα(x)~(1+|x|)^{−α}, and the two-sided admissibility inequality fixes i(ρα)=α. Centered large-ball oscillation grows as R^γ(log R)^β; the weighted BMO norm therefore forces γ<θ or γ=θ with β≤0. For sufficiency, direct gradient control on small r≤ρ, middle ρ≤r≤(1+|x|)/2 and large r ranges bounds the same quotient; θ<1/(1+α) protects small scales. Power potentials satisfy all finite reverse-Hölder orders, so Bui–Duong–Ky’s advertised sufficient commutator theorem applies in the stated θ range. No negative boundedness statement is claimed outside the symbol class. Independent radial centered-ball quadrature checked power-log scaling but is not a proof of sufficiency.
